name: Temporal context binding (TCM Howard-Kahana 2002)
description: Item-context binding mechanism where context vector drifts via random-walk update c_t = (1-rho) * c_{t-1} + rho * f(input_t), distinct from P^k cyclic-shift positional encoding via continuous context evolution. Bind item-context per temporal step: encode(item, t) = bind(item, c_t). Recall via context similarity nearest-neighbor. Howard-Kahana 2002 TCM Temporal Context Model + Polyn-Norman-Kahana 2009 CMR Context Maintenance and Retrieval. Brain analogue: hippocampal CA1 + MTL temporal context Sederberg-Howard-Kahana 2008 + Hasselmo 2012. Substrate-relevant: temporal-contiguity recall + lag-CRP-style retrieval + free-recall + episodic sequence memory. DISTINCT from math::T3/permutation_indexed_binding via continuous context drift vs discrete permutation. Empirically validated Cycle 50 PP-402 +0.37 contig-lift clean vs static-FHRR baseline + textbook lag-CRP signature reproduced + 3rd off-attractor mechanism candidate.

metadata.complexity: O(N) per encoding step + O(N*K) cleanup
